mapper.sql: SELECT materials.id, materials.name, materials.publisher, materials.note, materials.created, materials.status, materials.borrow, materials.material_type_id, material_types.name AS material_type_name FROM materials JOIN material_types ON materials.material_type_id = material_types.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO materials (name, publisher, note, material_type_id, created, borrow) VALUES (#{name}, #{publisher}, #{note}, #{materialType.id}, NOW(), #{borrow})
mapper.update: UPDATE materials SET name = #{name}, publisher = #{publisher}, note = #{note}, material_type_id = #{materialType.id} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE materials SET status = 'DEL' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM materials WHERE name = #{name} AND status !='DEL'
WHERE materials.borrow = 0 AND materials.status = 'ACT' ORDER BY materials.created DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
WHERE materials.borrow = 0 AND materials.status = 'ACT' ORDER BY materials.created DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM materials WHERE borrow = 0 AND status = 'ACT'
